notes.title: Linux Version is out.
notes.notes:
Hi Ya'll,
     First off I'd like to thank everyone for who purchased this game. You're all awesome and I hope you're enjoying it :). 
Secondly, The Linux version of this game is finally out! So now all you Ubuntu users can actually play the game. 
Thirdly, I think there's some kind of bug affecting some users and achievements. I'm having no problems on my end so it's hard to tell, however I think I may have added a fix in the latest patch. I'm going to continue working on the issue until I'm 100% sure it's resolved, but for now I thought I mine as well toss it in with the Linux update.

Also if you're experiencing any technical issues or otherwise please contact me at mattwillisgames@gmail.com . 

Have a pleasant day,
                                   Matt
